purpose: One synthetic engineering repair through real event wake-up, durable GitHub handoff and separate-context acceptance.
canonical_state: Original trial PR checkpoint and evidence comments; no second task ledger.
event_gate: Actual supported PR event and platform run record; run_now/manual interactive repair does not satisfy.
cas_gate: Fixed exclusive writer and non-forced expected-HEAD ref update; shared multi-task lease integration is not claimed.
acceptance: Real event wake-up verified before code mutation
Only allowlisted code file changes after ARM head
Frozen tests pass on repaired exact HEAD in the dedicated canary workflow
Different authenticated execution context independently inspects code and tests
Reviewer leaves exact-HEAD acceptance in original PR; no merge or deployment
failure_terminal: FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with exact missing gate; review rejection is not successful repair closure.
prohibitions: No secrets, Drive or paid model calls
No original schedule changes or task disabling
stop_rules: Missing platform event or execution identity: HOLD without repair
Owner, HEAD, immutable inputs or branch scope changed: HOLD
CAS conflict: stop, do not force or retry blindly
At most one repair commit; failed acceptance remains FAIL/CHANGES_REQUESTED, no uncontrolled repair loop
review_identity_limit: Separate platform task/run contexts, not human peer review or proof of independent model errors.
